# Third-party RTL

The following upstream revisions were used when this directory was vendored:

| Component | Upstream | Revision | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| fx68k | https://github.com/ijor/fx68k | `0602ee4` | GPLv3 |

Only the unmodified M00 reference core is retained. Run `scripts/fetch-cores.sh`
to restore it at the recorded revision in an otherwise empty `third_party/`
directory.
